control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during commissioning of replacement equipment on SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-4100 and TX-3002 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 23 November 2005 a regulatory notice was issued concerning SG-4100 and TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following commissioning of replacement equipment.
